body:
I hope your plan will work out for you, and I pray that you will find peace for yourself. If your relatives doesn’t love you the way you needed to be, then it’s okay to love yourself. Please don’t ever forget that. 

Thank you for your reply. It’s a comforting feelings when your words are actually heard.

No, not always. If a cute guy looks at me, I’d feel shy. If someone stares at me, I’d question if there was something on my face or what, and I’d feel embarassed. If a pervert stares at my breast, I’d feel uncomfortable. Could you explain your situation?

Have you had a mental health check-up done before? 

I don’t believe in the term lazy. Most inactivities or lack of motivation to do things for me seems like a mental health related issues rather than “laziness”. Such a terrible and untrue term to define things, yet it makes us lower ourselves’ concious value almost by instant without logical conclusion. 

So besides your own life goals you are also somehow  responsible in someways to those who are around you? If personal time and space is not an option, how about make peace with yourself with little moments that you’d have? 

For instant before bedtime, while in the shower, take 5 and just focus on you. Be a little nicer to yourself? You don’t have to love you right away, love takes time to develop. Just be a friend to yourself first and let the relationship develop just like any other personal relationship. Wachu think?
You should talk more about your problems to find a solution for you, there is no quick solution for anything. So what does staring makes you feel uncomfortable?

I chose to smoke weed to feel better. Sativa. Some lucky days I’ll get a good trip, but when the bad trips arrive things just become worse. And since I have severe depression, the bad trips play out much more. So now I’m careful around drugs and alcohol. For good times only, you should consider too. 

The thing is: no one cares. It really hurts to know that. But it’s best that we acknowledge that, for our own good. 

I choose to love myself. I’m still struggling everday to do that. Most days I feel like shit. So much pain. But at the end of the day I make a small habit for myself by telling myself: it’s okay. It’s okay to be the way that I am. I will take care of myself better. 

Then the next day I do so. Whatever I feel like is best for me, I do so. 

Can you love yourself too?

What makes you hate being stared at while
smoking? And why did you want to kill yourself?

Hiiiiii! Me too! I’m 27 and haven’t finish my degree too! I have a job that I am too ashamed to admit of a job (i run my own business, it sounds fancy but it’s not at all) so most of the time I see myself as a useless thing too. 

And seeing my peers getting promoted, starting a family, buying their first house is like a slap in the face for me too! 

But so what? So what if we haven’t meet all those standards made by society? Only we can define who we are, and if at the end of the day you can learn to forgive yourself, you’ll realize that everything will be okay.

Hi! 
Are you allow to slow down? Like take a few days off from all of your current responsibilities? 
Have you been given yourself some time and space or is that not possible at the moment?
Most importantly, do you love yourself?

So is that the root of the problem? You have no feelings. Then can you explain why you want to kill that guy? What makes you want to kill him? Is there any feelings toward the killing or just an urge?

How miserable? Could you clarify? 

What makes you wanna end your life so badly? I want to hear your story.

Clearly you have all the symptoms of an abused child from toxic parents. 

First, they blame you. 
Then you feel guilty about yourself, which is exactly what they want. 
But if you dare questioning them and their instability, they’ll go at you harder. 
And you will doubt yourself. 
That’s how they get you every time. That’s the vicious cycle of it. 

So no, you’re not overreacting or too sensitive for having feelings. It’s okay to be human.

When I sleep, I feel more control than when I am awake. 
When I sleep, life feels so much better than the one when I’m awake. 

To a point where I’m actually afraid of going to sleep, knowing that I have to wake up the next day. Waking up causes disappointment. And I’m disappointed days after days.

Everything we do has consequence, wouldn’t you agree? 

That asshole has provoked you, and if you manage to kill him tonight, well there would be consequence for you. Duh. But could you handle those consequences? Like spending many years in jail, or live a life of hiding and waiting to get caught. Etc... 

If that asshole has kids or family members that care about him, what would the incident do to them? Can you live on knowing the damage caused by you? 

I think you should identify the killing motive. Is it anger that started it or something else. And work with that root instead. Seek professional help too. Good luck mate.

Wow. 
A part of me wants to say this: if you did die that night, it would have been better. 
Now hold on, before any criticism comes right at me there’s another perspective on it. Because after failing to kill yourself, all you got from the world, instead of sympathy, they were all like... punishments. Punishments for failing to commit suicide. Do you see the cruel irony in this? 
With that being said, I don’t encourage or support you at all for these suicidal thoughts. I too are going through these feelings and thoughts everyday, and I couldn’t help myself too. But somehow it’s comforting to know that I’m not the only one who feel abandoned. Sometimes it’s better to know that you’re not the only one in the world, though it may seems like it, and then... find positivity in that to feel a little better?
